sections.content: Full summary of when to use each past tense.

items.spanish: Mientras llovía, leímos un libro. De repente, paró la lluvia.
items.english: While it was raining, we read a book. Suddenly, the rain stopped.

items.spanish: Estaba muy cansado cuando llegué a casa, así que me acosté enseguida.
items.english: I was very tired when I got home, so I went straight to bed.

sections.content: The two tenses work as a team. Think of a movie: imperfecto = the set design and camera panning over the scene. Indefinido = the cuts between shots, each one a new action.
